```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(readxl)
set.seed(1)
```

## Functions!

start small with Z scores
```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

turn it into function

```{r}

z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)){
    stop("Input x must be numeric.")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have more than 5 numbers")
  }
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}

z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

does it actually work?

```{r eval = FALSE}
#below do not work
z_scores(iris)
z_scores("English")
z_scores(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE))
z_scores(3)
```


## Mean and sd

```{r}
mean(x_vec)
sd(x_vec)
```

write a func that returns mean and sd of an input vector

```{r}
mean_and_sd = function(x){
  
  return_df = 
    tibble(
      mean = mean(x),
      sd = sd(x)
    )
  return(return_df)
}
```

check if it works

```{r}
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```

```{r}
mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```

## Motivate and write another one

```{r}
sim_df =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(40, 12, 3)
  )

sim_df |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```

```{r}
source("source/sim_mean_and_sd.R")
```

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(40,12,3)
```
